title: axonopus flexuosus
intro: Axonopus flexuosus, commonly known as bent grass or tropical bent grass, is a species of grass native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Axonopus flexuosus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
